notes: Each case replays one separately altered unlabeled dataset in temporary storage; there are no live detector or notification changes.
The January Chennai calibration is fixed; held-out cases did not select the thresholds.
A new flag appears on an altered reading that was not flagged at that time in the same method's unmodified control. Counts exclude already-flagged control readings.

A ramp starts at the first selected time and changes every observation for 24 hours, using its actual elapsed time. Missing endpoint, gaps over three hours and out-of-range perturbations are skipped, not filled.
Humidity is derived from temperature and dew point. Independent synthetic perturbations may produce physically inconsistent combinations.
Synthetic anomalies are not verified sensor faults; these counts are not real-world recall or false-positive rates.
